title: Birmingham teen wins Alibaba's $200,000 prize for his self-taught robotics business
summary_full: Suleymaan Khan, a brilliant self-taught robotics engineer hailing from Birmingham, has made waves at CoCreate Europe by securing a prestigious award. As the founder of SuleyNova Robotics, he created innovative educational robotics kits aimed at teaching coding and engineering concepts. Out of 20,000 competitors globally, the top 20 were chosen to pitch their inventions.
